title: Use a structured prompt with labeled sections (GOAL, REFERENCES, STYLE…
content:
Use a structured prompt with labeled sections (GOAL, REFERENCES, STYLE, CHARACTERS, CAMERA, timed beats) to control long-form continuity in Seedance (e.g., 0–4s, 4–9s, …, 25–30s) while keeping one continuous action.

Lock character identity by assigning separate reference images per character and explicitly restricting what each reference can influence (identity/face/costume/proportions/silhouette only), and forbid inheriting reference backgrounds/lighting/style.

Prevent identity bleed by explicitly stating “Never interchange [character refs]” and adding constraints like “Gold belongs only to Character A, orange only to Character B; never swap or merge.”

Use separate environment reference images for each location beat and specify that those refs define architecture/composition only, while the STYLE section overrides their rendering style.

Maintain spatial coherence by instructing “preserve screen direction, not real distance” when compressing multiple real-world locations into one continuous stylized space.

Reduce static shots by explicitly requiring constant motivated camera motion (whip pans, rising/plunging tracks, corkscrews, fast lateral tracking) and stating “Never static before the final collision.”

Improve fight readability by requiring every attack to produce a visible reaction/redirection/environmental consequence and banning “detached effects” or “contactless explosions.”

Control VFX consistency by defining energy behavior rules (e.g., “energy behaves as wet ink; splatter only on direction change/contact”) and tying debris/flares strictly to physical contact.

Avoid common generation failures by adding an explicit EXCLUDE list (no duplicates/extra fighters, no extra limbs/distorted anatomy, no face/identity swap, no color swap, no slow motion/hit-stop/locked camera, no text/logos).

es.content:
Usa un prompt estructurado con secciones etiquetadas (GOAL, REFERENCES, STYLE, CHARACTERS, CAMERA, timed beats) para controlar la continuidad de largo formato en Seedance (p. ej., 0–4s, 4–9s, …, 25–30s) mientras mantienes una sola acción continua.

Bloquea la identidad de los personajes asignando imágenes de referencia separadas para cada personaje y restringiendo explícitamente qué puede influir cada referencia (solo identidad/rostro/vestuario/proporciones/silueta), y prohíbe heredar fondos/iluminación/estilo de la referencia.

Evita el “identity bleed” indicando explícitamente “Never interchange [character refs]” y añadiendo restricciones como “Gold belongs only to Character A, orange only to Character B; never swap or merge.”

Usa imágenes de referencia de entorno separadas para cada beat de ubicación y especifica que esas referencias definen solo la arquitectura/composición, mientras que la sección STYLE anula su estilo de renderizado.

Mantén la coherencia espacial indicando “preserve screen direction, not real distance” cuando comprimas múltiples ubicaciones del mundo real en un único espacio estilizado continuo.

Reduce los planos estáticos exigiendo explícitamente movimiento constante y motivado de cámara (whip pans, rising/plunging tracks, corkscrews, fast lateral tracking) y estableciendo “Never static before the final collision.”

Mejora la legibilidad de la pelea exigiendo que cada ataque produzca una reacción visible/redirección/consecuencia ambiental y prohibiendo “detached effects” o “contactless explosions.”

Controla la consistencia de los VFX definiendo reglas de comportamiento de la energía (p. ej., “energy behaves as wet ink; splatter only on direction change/contact”) y vinculando los escombros/flare estrictamente al contacto físico.

Evita fallos comunes de generación añadiendo una lista EXCLUDE explícita (no duplicates/extra fighters, no extra limbs/distorted anatomy, no face/identity swap, no color swap, no slow motion/hit-stop/locked camera, no text/logos).

fr.content:
Utilisez un prompt structuré avec des sections étiquetées (GOAL, REFERENCES, STYLE, CHARACTERS, CAMERA, timed beats) pour contrôler la continuité sur la durée dans Seedance (par ex. 0–4s, 4–9s, …, 25–30s) tout en conservant une seule action continue.

Verrouillez l’identité des personnages en attribuant des images de référence distinctes à chaque personnage et en limitant explicitement ce que chaque référence peut influencer (identité/visage/costume/proportions/silhouette uniquement), et interdisez l’héritage des arrière-plans, de l’éclairage ou du style des références.

Évitez le mélange d’identités en indiquant explicitement « Never interchange [character refs] » et en ajoutant des contraintes comme « Gold belongs only to Character A, orange only to Character B; never swap or merge. »

Utilisez des images de référence d’environnement séparées pour chaque beat de lieu et précisez que ces références définissent uniquement l’architecture/la composition, tandis que la section STYLE remplace leur style de rendu.

Maintenez la cohérence spatiale en demandant « preserve screen direction, not real distance » lorsque vous compressez plusieurs lieux réels en un seul espace stylisé continu.

Réduisez les plans statiques en exigeant explicitement un mouvement de caméra constant et motivé (whip pans, rising/plunging tracks, corkscrews, fast lateral tracking) et en indiquant « Never static before the final collision. »

Améliorez la lisibilité des combats en exigeant que chaque attaque produise une réaction visible, une redirection ou une conséquence dans l’environnement, et en interdisant les « detached effects » ou les « contactless explosions ».

Contrôlez la cohérence des VFX en définissant des règles de comportement de l’énergie (par ex. « energy behaves as wet ink; splatter only on direction change/contact ») et en reliant strictement les débris/éclats aux contacts physiques.

Évitez les échecs de génération courants en ajoutant une liste EXCLUDE explicite (no duplicates/extra fighters, no extra limbs/distorted anatomy, no face/identity swap, no color swap, no slow motion/hit-stop/locked camera, no text/logos).

ja.content:
Seedanceで長尺の一貫性を制御するには、ラベル付きセクション（GOAL、REFERENCES、STYLE、CHARACTERS、CAMERA、timed beats）を備えた構造化されたpromptを使い、1つの連続したアクションを保ちながら、長時間の連続性を管理する（例：0–4s、4–9s、…、25–30s）。

各キャラクターごとに別々のreference imageを割り当て、各referenceが影響できる範囲を明確に制限することで、キャラクターのアイデンティティを固定する（identity/face/costume/proportions/silhouette のみ）。また、referenceの背景・lighting・styleを継承することは禁止する。

“Never interchange [character refs]” と明記し、さらに「Gold belongs only to Character A, orange only to Character B; never swap or merge.」のような制約を加えて、identity bleedを防ぐ。

各ロケーションのbeatごとに別々のenvironment reference imageを用意し、それらのreferenceはarchitecture/compositionのみを定義し、STYLEセクションがレンダリングスタイルを上書きするよう指定する。

複数の現実世界のロケーションを1つの連続した様式化空間に圧縮する場合は、「preserve screen direction, not real distance」と指示して空間的一貫性を維持する。

静止ショットを減らすには、常に動機づけられたカメラ移動（whip pans、rising/plunging tracks、corkscrews、fast lateral tracking）を明示的に要求し、「Never static before the final collision.」と記す。

戦闘の可読性を高めるには、すべての攻撃に対して目に見える反応／方向転換／環境への結果が生じるよう求め、「detached effects」や「contactless explosions」を禁止する。

VFXの一貫性を保つには、エネルギーの挙動ルールを定義する（例：「energy behaves as wet ink; splatter only on direction change/contact」）とともに、debrisやflaresを物理的接触に厳密に結び付ける。

よくある生成失敗を避けるために、明示的なEXCLUDEリストを追加する（重複する／余分な戦闘員なし、余分な手足や歪んだ人体構造なし、顔／アイデンティティの入れ替わりなし、色の入れ替わりなし、slow motion／hit-stop／locked cameraなし、テキスト／ロゴなし）。

ko.content:
구조화된 prompt를 사용해 라벨이 붙은 섹션(GOAL, REFERENCES, STYLE, CHARACTERS, CAMERA, timed beats)을 구성하면, 하나의 연속된 액션을 유지하면서 Seedance에서 장편 서사의 연속성을 제어할 수 있습니다(예: 0–4s, 4–9s, …, 25–30s).

캐릭터마다 별도의 reference image를 할당하고, 각 reference가 어떤 요소에만 영향을 줄 수 있는지(identity/face/costume/proportions/silhouette only) 명시적으로 제한하여 캐릭터 정체성을 고정하며, reference의 배경/조명/style을 절대 이어받지 못하도록 금지합니다.

“Never interchange [character refs]”라고 명시하고, “Gold belongs only to Character A, orange only to Character B; never swap or merge.” 같은 제약을 추가해 identity bleed를 방지합니다.

각 location beat마다 별도의 environment reference image를 사용하고, 해당 reference는 architecture/composition only를 정의하며 STYLE 섹션이 그 렌더링 스타일을 덮어쓴다고 명시합니다.

여러 실제 장소를 하나의 연속적인 스타일화된 공간으로 압축할 때는 “preserve screen direction, not real distance”라고 지시해 공간적 일관성을 유지합니다.

정적인 샷을 줄이기 위해 whip pans, rising/plunging tracks, corkscrews, fast lateral tracking 같은 지속적인 동기 부여 카메라 움직임을 명시적으로 요구하고, “Never static before the final collision.”이라고 적습니다.

모든 공격이 눈에 보이는 반응/방향 전환/환경적 결과를 만들어내도록 요구하고, “detached effects”나 “contactless explosions”는 금지해 전투의 가독성을 높입니다.

에너지의 동작 규칙을 정의해 VFX 일관성을 제어합니다(예: “energy behaves as wet ink; splatter only on direction change/contact”) 그리고 파편/플레어는 물리적 접촉에만 엄격히 연결합니다.

중복/추가 전투원 없음, 추가 팔다리/왜곡된 해부학 없음, 얼굴/정체성 교체 없음, 색상 교체 없음, 슬로 모션/hit-stop/고정 카메라 없음, 텍스트/로고 없음 등 명시적인 EXCLUDE 목록을 추가해 흔한 생성 실패를 방지합니다.

pt.content:
Use um prompt estruturado com seções rotuladas (GOAL, REFERENCES, STYLE, CHARACTERS, CAMERA, timed beats) para controlar a continuidade de longa duração no Seedance (por exemplo, 0–4s, 4–9s, …, 25–30s) enquanto mantém uma única ação contínua.

Trave a identidade dos personagens atribuindo imagens de referência separadas para cada personagem e restringindo explicitamente o que cada referência pode influenciar (apenas identidade/rosto/figurino/proporções/silhueta), além de proibir a herança de fundos/iluminação/estilo das referências.

Evite o vazamento de identidade declarando explicitamente “Never interchange [character refs]” e adicionando restrições como “Gold belongs only to Character A, orange only to Character B; never swap or merge.”

Use imagens de referência de ambiente separadas para cada beat de localização e especifique que essas referências definem apenas arquitetura/composição, enquanto a seção STYLE substitui o estilo de renderização delas.

Mantenha a coerência espacial instruindo “preserve screen direction, not real distance” ao comprimir múltiplas localizações do mundo real em um único espaço estilizado contínuo.

Reduza planos estáticos exigindo explicitamente movimento de câmera constante e motivado (whip pans, rising/plunging tracks, corkscrews, fast lateral tracking) e afirmando “Never static before the final collision.”

Melhore a legibilidade da luta exigindo que todo ataque produza uma reação visível/redirecionamento/consequência ambiental e proibindo “detached effects” ou “contactless explosions.”

Controle a consistência de VFX definindo regras de comportamento da energia (por exemplo, “energy behaves as wet ink; splatter only on direction change/contact”) e vinculando detritos/flashes estritamente ao contato físico.

Evite falhas comuns de geração adicionando uma lista explícita de EXCLUDE (no duplicates/extra fighters, no extra limbs/distorted anatomy, no face/identity swap, no color swap, no slow motion/hit-stop/locked camera, no text/logos).

zh.content:
使用结构化 prompt，并带有标注清晰的分区（GOAL、REFERENCES、STYLE、CHARACTERS、CAMERA、timed beats），来控制 Seedance 中的长篇连续性（例如 0–4s、4–9s、……、25–30s），同时保持一个连续动作。

通过为每个角色分别分配独立的参考图像，并明确限制每个参考图像只能影响哪些内容（仅限 identity/face/costume/proportions/silhouette），来锁定角色身份，同时禁止继承参考图中的背景/光照/style。

通过明确写出 “Never interchange [character refs]”，并添加诸如“Gold 只属于 Character A，orange 只属于 Character B；never swap or merge”之类的约束，来防止身份混淆。

为每个地点节拍使用独立的环境参考图像，并指定这些参考图只定义 architecture/composition，而由 STYLE 部分覆盖其渲染风格。

通过指示“preserve screen direction, not real distance”，在将多个现实中的地点压缩为一个连续的风格化空间时，保持空间连贯性。

通过明确要求持续且有动机的 camera motion（whip pans、rising/plunging tracks、corkscrews、fast lateral tracking），并写明“Never static before the final collision.”，来减少静态镜头。

通过要求每一次攻击都必须产生可见的反应/偏转/环境后果，并禁止“detached effects”或“contactless explosions”，来提升打斗的可读性。

通过定义能量行为规则（例如，“energy behaves as wet ink; splatter only on direction change/contact”），并将碎片/光效严格绑定到物理接触，来控制 VFX 一致性。

通过添加明确的 EXCLUDE 列表（no duplicates/extra fighters, no extra limbs/distorted anatomy, no face/identity swap, no color swap, no slow motion/hit-stop/locked camera, no text/logos），来避免常见的生成失败。
